Everyone wants to talk about "AI transformation." I want to talk about the invoice.

A company showed me their transformation deck last month. Forty slides. One number, on slide 38: 11,000 a month, for a tool that summarises meetings.

I asked who reads the summaries. Silence. Then: "the tool reads them."

That is not a transformation. That is a subscription with a keynote.

Read the invoice before the deck. The deck is written by the people who want the invoice to continue.
